Pro-Plantable Calendar (MDF) – Eco-Friendly Seed Paper Calendar with 12 Cards (7″×5″)

The Pro-Plantable Calendar (MDF) Eco-Friendly, 12 seed‐paper cards (7″×5″); DIY MDF stand w/ pen/pencil slot, tomato, basil & marigold seeds, Instructions included is the perfect blend of sustainability, creativity, and functional desk accessories. Designed for conscious consumers and brands, this eco-friendly plantable calendar is crafted to support greener lifestyles and impactful corporate gifting. Each month features a premium seed paper card embedded with tomato, basil, and marigold seeds, turning this desk calendar into a meaningful, zero-waste product that grows into plants once discarded.

This eco-friendly corporate gift stands out with its DIY MDF stand, a durable, reusable, and smooth-finish base that includes a convenient pen/pencil slot for everyday utility. The 7″×5″ plantable seed paper cards are printed with high-quality, non-toxic inks, making the Pro-Plantable Calendar both visually appealing and environmentally responsible.

With rising demand for sustainable gifts and plantable stationery, this seed paper calendar helps individuals and corporate brands reduce waste and support green initiatives. Each seed paper card can be planted after the month ends, reinforcing a powerful environmental message—“Don’t throw, grow!”

Why Choose the Pro-Plantable Calendar (MDF)?

In today’s eco-conscious world, customers, employees, and partners appreciate gifts that contribute positively to the environment. The Pro-Plantable Calendar (MDF) Eco-Friendly version is designed specifically for corporate gifting, employee welcome kits, festive giveaways, sustainable branding campaigns, and personal use. Its elegant design, practical use, and ecological benefits make it a top choice among corporate gifting suppliers in India.

Each of the 12 seed‐paper cards (7″×5″) contains high-quality plant seeds such as tomato, basil & marigold, ensuring successful sprouting when planted with the included instructions. The DIY MDF stand is easy to assemble, sturdy enough for long-term use, and adds a minimalistic aesthetic to any desk setup.

Benefits of Choosing a Plantable Desk

The plantable desk calendar category has gained immense popularity due to its minimal environmental impact. Unlike traditional paper calendars that end up in landfills, the transforms into fresh green plants, symbolizing growth, positivity, and sustainability. This makes it not only a functional office product but also a meaningful gift.

Brands looking for eco-friendly corporate gifts can leverage this calendar to convey their commitment to sustainability. The unique combination of seed paper cards, reusable stand, and the planting experience creates a memorable impression among recipients.

Best Choice for Corporate Gifting & Branding
